page.overview:
Who is Cyrulia?

Lady was a follower of the Betrayer Gods just before the Divergence. As an NPC, is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Cyrulia was a woman of pale greyish skin (almost corpse-like), clawed hands, and hundreds of very sharp and translucent fish-like teeth. She was dressed in a beautiful, shiny black gown.

She behaved politely and sinisterly at the same time.

Lady Cyrulia was a servant of the Betrayer Gods who, during the Calamity, acted as an ally and dignitary among the followers of other evil gods, even obtaining a privileged position in Rybad-Kol.
